cat > hera_scratch/md_fan.md <<'EOF'
## HERA — Landau fan across both CNP populations (plan step 4)

Runs 6–7 show resolved field structure on both carrier signs (ana handoff analysis: candidate electron FFT features near 7/30 T, hole near 5/12 T), with current 9.81–9.94 nA and no clipping. A density–field fan tests whether branches track separate bands, harmonics, or the two offset CNP populations in run 5; a frequency count at one density cannot decide stacking. The only measured voltage pair is **B_1–B_2**. The line uses run 5's fitted c_bg/c_tg=0.772765 and empirical D offset −0.013 V/nm; density remains **nominal, geometry anchored**, and resistance symmetry is only an operational definition of D=0. Preserve the gate-voltage axes; do not make a stacking-dependent density calibration.

The fan starts with a **0 T reference row** from the handoff zero state, follows low-field reconnaissance at 0.5–1.4 T in 0.1 T steps, then samples 1.5–10 T uniformly in 1/B (85 rows, Δ(1/B)=0.006746 T⁻¹). The fast line contains 111 co-swept TG/BG points, nominal n=−1.2…+3.2×10¹² cm⁻² in 0.04 increments, including both CNPs. This gives ~4.1 samples/cycle at F=36 T on the resolved segment; coarse low-B rows are not suitable for high-density FFT. Both lock-ins retain τ=0.3 s / 24 dB; each point has a 3 s interruptible dwell (10τ), Si stays at 0 V, heater ranges stay off. sr1 uses 100 µV (10 kΩ nominal full scale), with a 90% headroom stop.

**Coverage trade:** this spans both available carrier signs but omits the last ~0.07×10¹² cm⁻² at each TG-limited edge (full edge coverage would add ~22 min), negative B, and finite D. A reversed-field or finite-D repeat costs approximately another fan and is deferred until this map shows a discriminant. No gate-limit search, Si survey, or pacing change. **Price calculation:** 10 T / 0.137 T/min ≈73 min bare field motion; 10,656 points ×3.35 s ≈9.92 h; ~13 min row overhead, then 10% margin. This is calibrated from run 5's 1.098 s/point at 1 s dwell and runs 6–7's ~3.08 s magnet overhead above bare motion; extra co-gate writes/readbacks are included conservatively. Update the estimate after the first rows.

**Checks and decisions:** every inherited safety range, base thermometry freshness, field, Si, hardwired mapping, drive, lock-in settling, and gate pacing is checked before writing. Inspect the first point and the first complete 0 T row (compare run-5 CNP features and spot endpoints), then the first two finite-field rows; inspect every ~30 min thereafter and near 2 T for branch visibility. Every followed quantity has a live plot. Automatic stops flag |gate current|>1 nA, current collapse, clipping, nonfinite values, departure from base T, or field mismatch. If clipped, interrupt and reassess the acquisition range; if unsafe, notify and drop E0. Thermometry freshness is rechecked each row. End at 10 T with gates at the positive-density endpoint. **VTI exception:** a kernel interrupt does not stop an active magnet ramp; it continues to its last row target, and an unsafe ramp requires operator action on the supply. Re-read actual state after any interruption.
